messages:
sanjay: Quick sync — CloudVista wants a compact marketplace-ready reference architecture + Terraform module + sample app. GA target ~3 weeks. Who can own the module, sample app, CI/publish flow, and security checklist?

anya: I can take the Terraform module and the variable schema. Need security to confirm KMS/network constraints (if any).

kate: I can do the sample app and README. Question: should sample be a container image or just a repo & deploy script?

mike: My vote = container image + one-click deploy template. Marketplace prefers images for quick installs. Also need ARM builds for Ampere.

sanjay: Good call on multi-arch. Partner specifically mentioned Ampere SKUs. @cloud_partner_bot please ping CloudVista for registry + image permissions.

cloud_partner_bot: Ping sent to @Elaine (CloudVista) — awaiting confirmation. :white_check_mark:

oliver: For the module API, keep it minimal: VPC, subnets, security groups, autoscaling group / instance profile for inference, IAM role for fetching model objects. Expose outputs: endpoint_url, alb_dns, subnets.

anya: Draft usage snippet for module: 
```
module "cloudvista_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace/cloudvista-inference-module"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  model_repo = "cloudvista/gpt-serve"
}
```

kate: Sample app should demonstrate two modes: 1) private deployment (calls local endpoint) and 2) hosted fallback (calls Redwood API). Keep examples tiny (Node + curl).

mike: I'll wire the multi-arch build matrix in CI and add Dockerfile hints for quantized runtimes. We'll add recommended SKUs (ampere/m6a, g5 if partner wants GPU).

sanjay: Proposed timeline: week 0 (this week) — module scaffold + CI; week 1 — sample app + multi-arch builds; week 2 — partner review + security audit; week 3 — finalize marketplace package + SBOM. Volunteers? @anya @kate

anya: Module scaffold to be ready by Tue.

kate: Sample app prototype by Thu.

mike: CI multi-arch builders and publish workflow by Wed.

oliver: I'll draft the security checklist & KMS notes by Fri.

cloud_partner_bot: FYI marketplace package checklist: signed SBOM, minimal e2e smoke test, CLA for sample code. Created issue #682 in marketplace repo.

sanjay: Great. Next sync Friday 10am PT. If CloudVista confirms registry perms sooner we can accelerate. :rocket:

Elaine (CloudVista): Thanks — confirmed registry perms over DM. I'll upload the partner constraints doc to the shared drive and tag this thread when it's live.

mike: Awesome — once we have registry + constraints I'll push the initial images to the staging repo and share the digest here.

anya: I'll open the module repo and add a CHANGELOG + semver policy to match marketplace requirements.

kate: I'll start working on README sections: quickstart, deploy (container + terraform), local dev, and troubleshooting.

sanjay: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping infra-eng and mark the issue with `marketplace-onramp`.

oliver: Adding note: include a tiny smoke test that calls health endpoint and a sample inference request — that will satisfy marketplace e2e.

cloud_partner_bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly reminder for this thread set for Fri 09:50 PT. :bell:

sanjay: Thanks team — I'll drop a short project board with milestones after this message.
